HomeAbout.heading: From the brass city of India, to production lines worldwide

HomeFAQ.heading: Answers before you ask
HomeFAQ.subtitle: Everything purchase teams usually want to know. Still have questions? Our team responds within one business day.

faqs.q1: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faqs.a1: Our MOQ is flexible and depends on the component complexity and size. For standard components we typically start from 1,000 pieces, while for custom-developed parts we can support prototype and pilot quantities before scaling to full production.
faqs.q2: Can you manufacture parts from our drawings or samples?
faqs.a2: Yes — that is our core strength as OEM manufacturers. Share your 2D drawings, 3D models (STEP/IGES) or a physical sample, and our engineering team will review it, suggest optimisations if needed, and deliver a detailed quotation within 24–48 hours. All development is protected under NDA.
faqs.q3: Which quality certifications do you hold?
faqs.a3: Super Brass Industries operates an ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system. Our components are RoHS compliant, and we provide material test certificates, dimensional inspection reports and PPAP documentation on request.
faqs.q4: What are your typical lead times?
faqs.a4: Standard components ship in 2–3 weeks from order confirmation. Custom parts require 3–5 weeks including tooling and sample approval. For repeat orders we maintain safety stock programs that can reduce lead times to under a week.
faqs.q5: Which brass grades and finishes do you work with?
faqs.a5: We machine CW614N, CW617N, C36000, C38500, DZR and lead-free brass grades. Surface finishes include natural, nickel, tin, zinc, chrome and silver plating — all with verified plating thickness reports.
faqs.q6: Do you export? How are shipments packed?
faqs.a6: Yes, we currently export to 18+ countries across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Oceania. Components are packed in VCI-lined export-grade packaging with full traceability labelling, shipped via sea or air per your Incoterms (FOB, CIF, DDP).

hero.titleStart: Built in Jamnagar. Trusted by manufacturers
hero.subtitle: Since 2021, we have manufactured precision brass components for companies that cannot afford a single defective part. This is our story.

intro.heading: A young company with an old-school obsession: getting it right
intro.p1: Super Brass Industries was founded in 2021 in Jamnagar, Gujarat — the undisputed brass capital of India. Our founders grew up around lathes and turning centres, and started the company with a simple conviction: global buyers deserve a supplier who treats their drawing like a contract.
intro.p2: Today we operate a modern facility with CNC turning centres, high-speed traub machines, thread rolling, knurling and a dedicated quality lab. As OEM manufacturers, we serve automotive, electrical, gas and plumbing industry customers directly — with no trading layer in between.

journey.heading: From a workshop to a global facility

2012.title: The Beginning
2012.desc: Super Brass Industries is founded in Jamnagar — the brass capital of India — with a small workshop and a commitment to precision engineering.

2015.title: Building the Foundation
2015.desc: Expanded the facility and added CNC turning centres, establishing the core machining capabilities that define the company today.

2017.title: Scaling Production
2017.desc: Installed high-speed traub machines and grew monthly output to serve automotive and electrical industry clients across India.

2019.title: Quality Systems
2019.desc: Implemented formal quality management processes, in-house inspection lab, and material traceability systems across all production lines.

2021.title: Going Global
2021.desc: Shipped the first international consignments to the UAE and Germany, entering global OEM supply chains for the first time.

2024.title: ISO 9001:2015 Certified
2024.desc: Achieved ISO certification, crossed 120 active clients including automotive OEM suppliers and electrical majors across 18+ countries.

2026.title: The Road Ahead
2026.desc: Commissioning a new automated facility with robotic loading, inline vision inspection, and doubled export capacity.
